notes.title: Pimiko Plus is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26070636/bb7788d8dad29b8201a9293ab3a828bb5f96cbcc.png[/img]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/732030/Pimiko_Plus/]That's right, folks[/url], a new Delmunsoft game is coming! It's a coffee-break trade sim/RPG hybrid starring Ruho, and it comes with...
[list]
[*] Steam achievements!
[*] A nice PDF manual!
[*] Delmunsoft style!
[*] Post-1990s screen resolution!
[/list]
If you like the idea of hawking floppy disks, medical supplies, and assault rifles for big bucks while defending yourself from trigger-happy bandits, please keep an eye out.
